title: Food ration rotation with allergies and medicine needs
summary: A meal rotation method for emergencies where limited food must also respect allergies, diabetes risk, medicines that require food, infants, older adults, and heavy work.
content: Core sequence: 1) Write each person’s cannot-eat items, must-eat-with-medicine times, and high-energy work periods before opening shared food. 2) Use the safest foods for allergy-sensitive people first; others can accept more flexible substitutes. 3) Keep a small reserve of plain food for nausea, medication timing, and people returning from evacuation. 4) Record who ate what when supplies are tight so mistakes are seen before the next meal.
